title: Cloudplexity
abstract:
The publication Cloudplexity is the result of a collaboration between Spanish artist Mario Santamaría and Informal Office. The book shares its title with the artist’s exhibition, which took place in 2019. We frequently talk about the ‘Cloud,’ but can we ever agree on what it actually looks like? Cloudplexity explores various representations of the Internet and the construction of the Cloud metaphor as a form of connectivity. The artist has collected different drawings used to represent the Internet in patent applications submitted to the US Patent Office since 1979. Mario Santamaría is a contemporary visual artist who works across a wide range of media, including photography, video, performance, and websites. He is also the co-founder of Trama34, a space established in 2016 in L’Hospitalet de Llobregat.

Book design for Mario Santamaría’s Cloudplexity exhibition.
I collaborated with the Informal Office team to design the book.
